<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Story Learning Lab - Spelling Study Sheet</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Andika&display=swap">
<style>
/* ===================== App UI (all rules scoped to .sll-app) ===================== */
.sll-app, .sll-app * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.sll-app {
  --blue: #2b5b84; --blue-dark: #1f4666; --blue-soft: #eaf1f8;
  --amber: #f5a623; --amber-dark: #d98d0b;
  --ink: #1f2d3a; --muted: #5d6f80; --line: #d9e4ee; --bg: #f1f6fa;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--bg);
  padding: 24px 16px 40px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.sll-wrap { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }

.sll-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.sll-mark { width: 46px; height: 46px; flex: none; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--blue); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.sll-app .sll-title-main { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; color: var(--blue); }
.sll-app .sll-tagline { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--muted); }

.sll-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 380px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; align-items: start; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .sll-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

.sll-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(31, 70, 102, .07); }
.sll-controls { padding: 4px 18px 18px; }
.sll-field { padding: 15px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sll-field.sll-last { border-bottom: 0; }
.sll-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); }
.sll-sublabel { display: block; margin: 12px 0 6px; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.sll-hint { margin: 7px 0 0; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--muted); }
.sll-hint.sll-bad { color: #b3261e; font-weight: 600; }

.sll-app select, .sll-app textarea, .sll-app input[type="text"] {
  width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #c5d3df; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
  font: inherit; font-size: .95rem;
}
.sll-app textarea { min-height: 130px; resize: vertical; line-height: 1.5; }
.sll-app input + textarea, .sll-app textarea + textarea { margin-top: 8px; }
.sll-app button { font: inherit; }
.sll-app select:focus-visible, .sll-app textarea:focus-visible, .sll-app input:focus-visible, .sll-app button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(74, 144, 226, .5); outline-offset: 1px;
}

.sll-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: var(--blue-soft); border-radius: 12px; }
.sll-seg button { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--blue); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.sll-seg button:hover { background: rgba(43, 91, 132, .08); }
.sll-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(31, 70, 102, .35); }

.sll-actions { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding-top: 16px; }
.sll-btn { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .08s ease; }
.sll-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); }
.sll-btn[disabled] { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; }
.sll-btn-primary { background: var(--amber); color: #2a1d00; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--amber-dark); }
.sll-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: var(--blue); border: 2px solid var(--blue); }
.sll-btn-small { width: auto; min-height: 40px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: .9rem; }

.sll-preview { padding: 14px; min-width: 0; }
.sll-preview-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.sll-preview-title { font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); }
.sll-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sll-switch-track { width: 44px; height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; background: #b9c8d6; position: relative; transition: background .15s; }
.sll-switch-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3); transition: transform .15s; }
.sll-switch[aria-checked="true"] .sll-switch-track { background: var(--blue); }
.sll-switch[aria-checked="true"] .sll-switch-track::after { transform: translateX(18px); }
#sll-notice { display: none; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: .9rem; background: #fff6e5; border: 1px solid #f0c36b; color: #6b4300; }
#sll-notice.sll-error { background: #fdecec; border-color: #f0a3a3; color: #8a1f1f; }
.sll-stage { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #e3ecf4; overflow: hidden; }
.sll-paper { position: relative; flex: none; background: #fff; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(31, 70, 102, .2); overflow: hidden; }
.sll-paper-inner { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; transform-origin: top left; }
.sll-tip { margin: 12px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
#sll-cover { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 99999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #fff; color: #2b5b84; font: 700 1.2rem 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; }

/* ===================== Worksheet page (Letter 816 x 1050 px, or A4 793 x 1116 px) =====================
   Three sections: 1 match (5 words), 2 fill in the blank (5 sentences, word bank), 3 copy (all 10 words).
   Row heights and text sizes shrink just enough to keep everything on one page.
   Selectors depend only on .sll-sheet / .ps-* because html2pdf clones the sheet. */
.sll-sheet {
  padding: 36px 56px 26px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
  background: #fff; color: #111; overflow: hidden;
  font-family: 'Calibri', 'Carlito', 'Arial', sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: left;
}
.sll-sheet, .sll-sheet * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.sll-sheet > * { flex-shrink: 0; }
.sll-sheet .ps-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }

.sll-sheet .ps-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.sll-sheet .ps-logo { display: block; height: 46px; width: auto; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.sll-sheet .ps-title { text-align: center; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; color: #2b5b84; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sub { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 15px; color: #555; text-align: center; }
.sll-sheet .ps-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 30px; width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; }
.sll-sheet .ps-field { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }
.sll-sheet .ps-field span { display: inline-block; width: 230px; height: 18px; border-bottom: 2px solid #111; }
.sll-sheet .ps-badge { display: inline-block; margin-top: 6px; padding: 1px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: #f5a623; color: #1f1400; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }

.sll-sheet .ps-h { margin: 0 0 8px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid #2b5b84; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #2b5b84; }

/* 1. Study rows: word, definition, example sentence, practice lines */
.sll-sheet .ps-h { margin: 0 0 6px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid #2b5b84; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #2b5b84; }
.sll-sheet .ps-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-top: 12px; }
.sll-sheet .ps-srow { font-size: var(--fs, 18px); padding: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .02) 0 calc(var(--row, 36px) * .06); border-bottom: 1px solid #d5dee8; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sline { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; line-height: 1.25; }
.sll-sheet .ps-snum { flex: 0 0 1.8em; font-weight: 700; color: #1f4666; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sword { flex: 0 0 auto; font-weight: 700; color: #1f4666; background: #ffe766; padding: 0 .2em; border-radius: 3px; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sdef { flex: 1 1 auto; color: #111; }
.sll-sheet .ps-stlabel { flex: 0 0 auto; align-self: center; font-size: .8em; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; color: #2b5b84; white-space: nowrap; }
.sll-sheet .ps-stick { flex: 0 0 auto; align-self: center; width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; border: 2px solid #2b5b84; border-radius: 3px; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sex { margin: 2px 0 0 1.8em; font-style: italic; color: #222; line-height: 1.3; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sexblank { margin: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .3) 0 0 1.8em; height: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .5); border-bottom: 1.5px solid #7b8590; }
.sll-sheet .ps-hw { font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; color: #1f4666; }
.sll-sheet .ps-gstrip { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; height: calc(var(--row, 36px) * 1.02); margin: calc(var(--row, 36px) * -.08) 0 0 1.8em; }
.sll-sheet .ps-bl { display: inline-block; width: 0; height: 0; }
.sll-sheet .ps-gl { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 0; }
.sll-sheet .ps-gt { bottom: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .9); border-top: 1px solid #9aa6b2; }
.sll-sheet .ps-gm { bottom: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .665); border-top: 1px dashed #b7c1cb; }
.sll-sheet .ps-gb { bottom: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .19); border-top: 1.5px solid #7b8590; }
.sll-sheet .ps-trace { flex: 0 0 46%; position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: 'Andika', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Arial', sans-serif; font-size: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .95); line-height: 1; color: #b3bcc6; white-space: nowrap; padding-left: .12em; }
.sll-sheet .ps-wcell { flex: 1 1 auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: 'Andika', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Arial', sans-serif; font-size: calc(var(--row, 36px) * .95); line-height: 1; color: #2b5b84; }
.sll-sheet .ps-answord { font-style: italic; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sign { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 10px; }
.sll-sheet .ps-sign span { flex: 1; height: 18px; border-bottom: 2px solid #111; }
.sll-sheet .ps-foot { margin-top: auto; text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; color: #555; }
</style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0">

<div class="sll-app">
  <div class="sll-wrap">

    <header class="sll-header">
      <div class="sll-mark" aria-hidden="true">10</div>
      <div>
        <h1 class="sll-title-main">Spelling Study Sheet</h1>
        <p class="sll-tagline">Story Learning Lab: words, meanings, example sentences and practice, all on one page</p>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div class="sll-layout">

      <!-- Controls -->
      <section class="sll-card sll-controls" aria-label="Study sheet settings">

        <div class="sll-field">
          <span class="sll-label" id="ir-grade-label">Into Reading word list</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="ir-grade" role="group" aria-labelledby="ir-grade-label">
            <button type="button" data-grade="1">Grade 1</button>
            <button type="button" data-grade="2">Grade 2</button>
            <button type="button" data-grade="3">Grade 3</button>
          </div>
          <label class="sll-sublabel" for="ir-mod">Module</label>
          <select id="ir-mod" aria-label="Into Reading module"></select>
          <div class="sll-actions" style="margin-top:10px">
            <button type="button" class="sll-btn sll-btn-outline sll-btn-small" id="ir-back">Back 10</button>
            <button type="button" class="sll-btn sll-btn-outline sll-btn-small" id="ir-next">Next 10</button>
          </div>
          <p class="sll-hint" id="ir-status"></p>
        </div>

        <div class="sll-field">
          <label class="sll-label" for="sll-title">Sheet title</label>
          <input type="text" id="sll-title" maxlength="50" value="Spelling Study Sheet" aria-label="Sheet title">

          <label class="sll-sublabel" for="sll-words">Ten words for the test</label>
          <textarea id="sll-words" rows="12" aria-label="Ten words, meanings and example sentences, one per line" placeholder="light: not heavy | The box was light, so I could carry it alone.&#10;because: for the reason that | I stayed home because I was sick.&#10;..."></textarea>
          <p class="sll-hint">One word per line, in this format: <strong>word: meaning | example sentence</strong>. The example sentence can be longer, and the word will be highlighted in it.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="sll-field">
          <span class="sll-label" id="sll-page-label">Paper size</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-page" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-page-label">
            <button type="button" data-page="letter">Letter</button>
            <button type="button" data-page="a4">A4</button>
          </div>
          
          
          <span class="sll-sublabel" id="sll-sign-label">Parent signature line</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-sign" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-sign-label">
            <button type="button" data-sign="yes">Show</button>
            <button type="button" data-sign="no">Hide</button>
          </div>
          <span class="sll-sublabel" id="sll-foot-label">Story Learning Lab footer</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-foot" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-foot-label">
            <button type="button" data-foot="show">Show</button>
            <button type="button" data-foot="hide">Hide</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sll-actions sll-field sll-last" style="padding-bottom:0">
          <button type="button" class="sll-btn sll-btn-primary" id="sll-pdf">Download Worksheet PDF</button>
          <button type="button" class="sll-btn sll-btn-outline" id="sll-key">Download Answer Key PDF</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Live preview of the printed page -->
      <section class="sll-card sll-preview" aria-label="Study sheet preview">
        <div class="sll-preview-bar">
          <span class="sll-preview-title">Study sheet preview</span>
          <button type="button" class="sll-switch" id="sll-answer-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="false">
            <span class="sll-switch-track"></span>Show answers
          </button>
        </div>
        <div id="sll-notice" role="status"></div>
        <div class="sll-stage" id="sll-stage">
          <div class="sll-paper" id="sll-paper"><div class="sll-paper-inner" id="sll-paper-inner"></div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="sll-tip">Each word has its meaning, an example sentence, a box to tick when learned, and practice lines.</p>
      </section>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // Small Story Learning Lab logo, cropped and downsized so the file stays self-contained
  var LOGO_SRC = "data:image/png;base64,";

  var PAGES = {
    letter: { w: 816, h: 1050, fmt: 'letter' },
    a4: { w: 793, h: 1116, fmt: 'a4' }
  };
  var PAD_TOP = 36, PAD_BOTTOM = 26, MIN_GAP = 10;
  var TOTAL_N = 10;

  var SAMPLE_WORDS = [
    'light: not heavy | The box was light, so I could carry it alone.',
    'because: for the reason that | I stayed home because I was sick.',
    'bring: come with somebody or something | Please bring your book to school tomorrow.',
    'think: use your mind to form ideas | I think we should go to the park.',
    'watch: look at something for a time | We watch the birds in the garden every morning.',
    'friend: a person you know well and like | My best friend lives next door.',
    'school: a place where students learn | Every morning I walk to school with my sister.',
    'weather: rain, sun, wind and snow | The weather is warm and sunny today.',
    'kitchen: the room where you cook food | My mom cooks dinner in the kitchen.',
    'healthy: good for your body | Eating fruit keeps you healthy.'
  ].join('\n');

  var settings = { page: 'letter', logo: true, foot: true, sign: true };
  var vocab = [];       // { word, def, ex }
  var showAnswers = false;
  var debounce = null;

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]; }); }

  function setNotice(msg, isError) {
    var n = $('sll-notice');
    if (!msg) { n.style.display = 'none'; n.textContent = ''; return; }
    n.textContent = msg;
    n.className = isError ? 'sll-error' : '';
    n.style.display = 'block';
  }

  /* ---------- Reading the input: word: meaning | example sentence ---------- */
  function readVocab() {
    var seen = {}, out = [];
    $('sll-words').value.replace(/\r/g, '').split('\n').forEach(function (raw) {
      var line = raw.trim();
      if (!line) return;
      var parts = line.split('|');
      var head = parts[0].trim(), ex = parts.slice(1).join('|').trim();
      var m = head.match(/^(.+?)\s*(?::|=|\t|\s[-–—]\s)\s*(.+)$/);
      var word = (m ? m[1] : head).trim(), def = m ? m[2].trim() : '';
      var key = word.toLowerCase();
      if (!word || seen[key]) return;
      seen[key] = true;
      out.push({ word: word, def: def, ex: ex });
    });
    return out.slice(0, TOTAL_N);
  }

  // Shows the example sentence with the word (or a word form such as a plural or -ed) in bold
  function highlight(sentence, word) {
    if (!word) return esc(sentence);
    var re = new RegExp(word.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + "[\\w’'\\-]*", 'i');
    var m = re.exec(sentence);
    if (!m) return esc(sentence);
    return esc(sentence.slice(0, m.index)) + '<b class="ps-hw">' + esc(m[0]) + '</b>' + esc(sentence.slice(m.index + m[0].length));
  }

  /* ---------- The page ---------- */
  function sheetHTML(o) {
    var P = PAGES[settings.page];
    var title = $('sll-title').value.trim() || 'Spelling Study Sheet';
    var head = '<div class="ps-head">' +
      (settings.logo ? '<img class="ps-logo" src="' + LOGO_SRC + '" alt="">' : '') +
      '<div class="ps-title">' + esc(title) + '</div>' +
      (o.answers ? '<div class="ps-badge">Answer Key</div>' : '') +
      '<div class="ps-top"><div class="ps-field">Name:<span></span></div><div class="ps-field">Date:<span></span></div></div></div>';

    var rows = vocab.map(function (v, i) {
      var first = o.answers ? esc(v.word) : '';
      return '<div class="ps-srow">' +
        '<div class="ps-sline"><span class="ps-snum">' + (i + 1) + '.</span><span class="ps-sword">' + esc(v.word) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="ps-sdef">' + esc(v.def) + '</span><span class="ps-stlabel">I know it</span><span class="ps-stick"></span></div>' +
        (v.ex ? '<div class="ps-sex">' + highlight(v.ex, v.word) + '</div>' : '') +
        '<div class="ps-gstrip"><div class="ps-gl ps-gt"></div><div class="ps-gl ps-gm"></div><div class="ps-gl ps-gb"></div>' +
          '<span class="ps-trace">' + esc(v.word) + '<span class="ps-bl"></span></span><span class="ps-wcell">' + first + '</span></div>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');

    var body = '<div class="ps-body"><div class="ps-sec"><div class="ps-h">Learn each word. Tick the box when you know it, then practise writing it.</div>' +
      rows + '</div></div>';

    var sign = settings.sign ? '<div class="ps-sign">Parent or guardian signature:<span></span></div>' : '';
    var foot = settings.foot ? '<div class="ps-foot">Created with Story Learning Lab. Visit www.storylearninglab.com for more classroom resources.</div>' : '';

    return '<div class="sll-sheet" style="width:' + P.w + 'px;height:' + P.h + 'px">' + head + body + sign + foot + '</div>';
  }

  // Shrinks the rows and text until everything fits. The sheet must be in the document to measure.
  function fitSheet(sheet) {
    var avail = PAGES[settings.page].h - PAD_TOP - PAD_BOTTOM;
    function need() {
      var t = 0, kids = sheet.children;
      for (var i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) t += kids[i].offsetHeight;
      return t + (kids.length - 1) * MIN_GAP;
    }
    var row = 36, fs = 18;
    function apply() {
      sheet.style.setProperty('--row', row + 'px');
      sheet.style.setProperty('--fs', fs + 'px');
    }
    apply();
    while (need() > avail && (row > 20 || fs > 12)) {
      if (row > 20) row -= 1;
      if (fs > 12 && need() > avail) fs -= 0.5;
      apply();
    }
    // Spare room: grow the rows and text so the page is filled evenly
    if (need() <= avail) {
      while (row < 48 && fs < 22) {
        row += 1; fs += 0.5; apply();
        if (need() > avail) { row -= 1; fs -= 0.5; apply(); break; }
      }
    }
    return need() <= avail;
  }

  /* Places the three guidelines from where each word's baseline actually falls in the chosen font */
  function drawGuides(sheet) {
    sheet.querySelectorAll('.ps-gstrip').forEach(function (st) {
      var tr = st.querySelector('.ps-trace');
      var pr = tr && tr.querySelector('.ps-bl');
      if (!pr) return;
      var F = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(tr).fontSize);
      var base = tr.offsetTop + pr.offsetTop;
      var gt = st.querySelector('.ps-gt'), gm = st.querySelector('.ps-gm'), gb = st.querySelector('.ps-gb');
      gt.style.bottom = 'auto'; gt.style.top = (base - 0.78 * F) + 'px';
      gm.style.bottom = 'auto'; gm.style.top = (base - 0.5 * F) + 'px';
      gb.style.bottom = 'auto'; gb.style.top = base + 'px';
    });
  }

  var ir = { grade: '1', mod: '1', page: 0 };

  function irModules() {
    var mods = INTO[ir.grade] || {};
    return Object.keys(mods).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b); });
  }

  function irRefreshOptions() {
    var sel = $('ir-mod');
    sel.innerHTML = irModules().map(function (m) {
      return '<option value="' + m + '">Module ' + m + ': ' + esc(INTO[ir.grade][m].n) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    sel.value = ir.mod;
  }

  // Fills the word box with the next ten words of the chosen module
  function irLoad() {
    var mod = INTO[ir.grade] && INTO[ir.grade][ir.mod];
    if (!mod) return;
    var list = mod.w, total = list.length;
    var start = ir.page * TOTAL_N;
    if (start >= total) { ir.page = Math.max(0, Math.floor((total - 1) / TOTAL_N)); start = ir.page * TOTAL_N; }
    var part = list.slice(start, start + TOTAL_N);
    $('sll-words').value = part.map(function (x) { return x[0] + ': ' + x[1]; }).join('\n');
    $('sll-title').value = 'Into Reading Grade ' + ir.grade + ' · Module ' + ir.mod;
    $('ir-status').textContent = 'Words ' + (start + 1) + ' to ' + Math.min(start + TOTAL_N, total) + ' of ' + total + '. Example sentences are left blank for students to write.';
    $('ir-back').disabled = ir.page === 0;
    $('ir-next').disabled = start + TOTAL_N >= total;
    renderPreview();
  }

  function syncState() {
    vocab = readVocab();
  }

  function renderPreview() {
    syncState();
    var warn = [];
    if (vocab.length < TOTAL_N) warn.push('Add ' + TOTAL_N + ' words (you have ' + vocab.length + ').');
    else if (vocab.some(function (v) { return !v.def; })) warn.push('Each word needs a meaning after the colon.');

    var inner = $('sll-paper-inner');
    if (!vocab.length) {
      inner.innerHTML = '';
      setNotice('Type ten words with meanings and example sentences to build the sheet.', true);
      fitPaper();
      return;
    }
    inner.innerHTML = sheetHTML({ answers: showAnswers });
    var fits = fitSheet(inner.firstElementChild);
    drawGuides(inner.firstElementChild);
    fitPaper();
    if (!fits) setNotice('That is too much for one page. Please shorten the sentences or meanings.', true);
    else if (warn.length) setNotice(warn.join(' '), false);
    else setNotice('', false);
  }

  function fitPaper() {
    var W = PAGES[settings.page].w, H = PAGES[settings.page].h;
    var avail = $('sll-stage').clientWidth - 32;
    var scale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, avail / W));
    $('sll-paper').style.width = (W * scale) + 'px';
    $('sll-paper').style.height = (H * scale) + 'px';
    $('sll-paper-inner').style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ')';
  }

  function syncControls() {
    function press(sel, attr, test) {
      document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(test(b.dataset[attr]))); });
    }
    press('[data-page]', 'page', function (v) { return v === settings.page; });
    press('[data-logo]', 'logo', function (v) { return (v === 'show') === settings.logo; });
    press('[data-sign]', 'sign', function (v) { return (v === 'yes') === settings.sign; });
    press('[data-foot]', 'foot', function (v) { return (v === 'show') === settings.foot; });
    press('[data-grade]', 'grade', function (v) { return v === ir.grade; });
    $('sll-answer-switch').setAttribute('aria-checked', String(showAnswers));
  }

  /* ---------- PDF ---------- */
  async function exportPDF(keyMode, button) {
    syncState();
    if (!vocab.length) { setNotice('Type ten words with meanings and example sentences first.', true); return; }

    var P = PAGES[settings.page];
    var label = button.textContent;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Preparing PDF…';

    var cover = document.createElement('div');
    cover.id = 'sll-cover';
    cover.textContent = 'Preparing your PDF…';
    document.body.appendChild(cover);
    var scrollY = window.scrollY;
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);

    var holder = document.createElement('div');
    holder.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:' + P.w + 'px;';
    holder.innerHTML = sheetHTML({ answers: keyMode });
    document.body.appendChild(holder);
    var sheet = holder.firstElementChild;
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.load) await document.fonts.load("40px 'Andika'").catch(function () {});
    var fits = fitSheet(sheet);
    drawGuides(sheet);

    var opt = {
      margin: 0,
      filename: keyMode ? 'My-Spelling-Study-Sheet-Answer-Key.pdf' : 'My-Spelling-Study-Sheet.pdf',
      image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.98 },
      html2canvas: { scale: 2, useCORS: true, logging: false, scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, backgroundColor: '#ffffff' },
      jsPDF: { unit: 'mm', format: P.fmt, orientation: 'portrait' }
    };

    try {
      if (!fits) throw new Error('too-many');
      var logo = new Image();
      logo.src = LOGO_SRC;
      await logo.decode().catch(function () {});
      await html2pdf().set(opt).from(sheet).save();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('PDF generation failed:', err);
      setNotice(err && err.message === 'too-many'
        ? 'That is too much for one page. Please shorten the sentences or meanings.'
        : 'Sorry, the PDF could not be created. Please try again.', true);
    } finally {
      holder.remove();
      cover.remove();
      window.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = label;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- Wire everything up ---------- */
  function init() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.page = b.dataset.page; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-logo]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.logo = b.dataset.logo === 'show'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-sign]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.sign = b.dataset.sign === 'yes'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-foot]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.foot = b.dataset.foot === 'show'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-grade]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { ir.grade = b.dataset.grade; ir.mod = irModules()[0]; ir.page = 0; irRefreshOptions(); irLoad(); syncControls(); });
    });
    $('ir-mod').addEventListener('change', function () { ir.mod = this.value; ir.page = 0; irLoad(); });
    $('ir-next').addEventListener('click', function () { ir.page++; irLoad(); });
    $('ir-back').addEventListener('click', function () { if (ir.page > 0) ir.page--; irLoad(); });
    $('sll-words').addEventListener('input', function () { clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = setTimeout(renderPreview, 250); });
    $('sll-title').addEventListener('input', renderPreview);
    $('sll-answer-switch').addEventListener('click', function () { showAnswers = !showAnswers; syncControls(); renderPreview(); });
    $('sll-pdf').addEventListener('click', function () { exportPDF(false, this); });
    $('sll-key').addEventListener('click', function () { exportPDF(true, this); });

    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(fitPaper).observe($('sll-stage'));
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitPaper);

    irRefreshOptions();
    $('sll-words').value = SAMPLE_WORDS;
    syncControls();
    renderPreview();
    // Re-measure once the handwriting font has really loaded (on some PCs it arrives after the first layout)
    if (document.fonts) {
      if (document.fonts.load) document.fonts.load("20px 'Andika'").then(renderPreview, renderPreview);
      if (document.fonts.addEventListener) document.fonts.addEventListener('loadingdone', renderPreview);
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', renderPreview);
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
